title: The Permanent job at the mill
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：permanent　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 permanent 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the guide wrote of ① a permanent job at the mill in the guidebook, and everybody in the valley said at once that it was ② so permanent that nobody in the valley would go near it. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the guide, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the permanent ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the permanent job at the mill that anybody there had ever seen, or so the guidebook for July 1984 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too permanent to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the permanent ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a permanent mark on the wall, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as permanent as the mark on the wall they had once had in the old valley. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was permanent or not, and he said so.

By 1997 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something permanent, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next valley called the whole plan ⑧ quite permanent; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the guidebook kept the names of the permanent ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2000, in public, she wrote of another permanent job at the mill in the same guidebook, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ no less permanent than anybody had expected. ⑩ The permanent mark on the wall that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2002, was the one she could never quite name; the permanent ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 永久（前置定语 a permanent job at the mill：1990 年向导在旅行手册里记下的那件永久的长期工作）
B. adj. 永久／长期（两处加强说法：so permanent that … 与 no less permanent than …）
C. adj. 永久／长期（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 永久（表语 too permanent to do：母亲觉得它太永久，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 长期（前置定语 a permanent mark on the wall：叔叔把整件事称作一桩长期的印记）
F. adj. 长期（同级比较 as permanent as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩墙上永久的印记相比）
G. adj. 长期（后置定语 something permanent：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 长期（受程度副词修饰 quite permanent：那位旅人的评价）

items.q: a permanent job at the mill
the permanent job at the mill that
a permanent mark on the wall
The permanent mark on the wall that

answers.why: permanent 意为“永久”，1990 年向导在旅行手册里记下的是“一件永久的长期工作”，此处作前置定语 a permanent job at the mill。
permanent 意为“永久”，此处用 so permanent that 结构，说它永久到山谷里没人敢靠近。
permanent 意为“永久”，旅行手册上 七月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的永久磨坊里的长期工作，等于最高级的说法。
permanent 意为“永久”，母亲认为这件东西“太永久了，谁也用不上”，too permanent to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
permanent 意为“长期”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩长期的印记”，此处作前置定语 a permanent mark on the wall。
permanent 意为“长期”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩墙上永久的印记一样长期”，同级比较用 as permanent as。
permanent 意为“长期”，旅行手册上那半行字要的是“长期的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something permanent。
permanent 意为“长期”，邻山谷来的那位旅人认为这套计划“相当长期”，quite 修饰原级 permanent。
permanent 意为“长期”，no less permanent than 表示“其长期不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之长期不亚于任何人的预料。
permanent 意为“长期”，母亲 2002 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的长期印记”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1990 年，向导在旅行手册里记下了一件永久的长期工作。（a permanent job at the mill）
它永久到山谷里没有一个人敢靠近。（so permanent that …）
母亲觉得它太永久，谁也用不上。（too permanent to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩长期的印记。（a permanent mark on the wall）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩墙上永久的印记一样长期。（as permanent as …）
到了 1997 年，旅行手册上只剩半行字：要的是一件长期的东西。（something permanent）
answers: In 1990 the guide wrote of a permanent job at the mill in the guidebook.
It was so permanent that nobody in the valley would go near it.
My mother thought it too permanent to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a permanent mark on the wall.
He said nobody would call it as permanent as the mark on the wall they had once had.
By 1997 the guidebook asked for nothing but something permanent.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 permanent 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the guide wrote of a permanent job at the mill in the guidebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the permanent job at the mill that anybody there had ever seen, or so the guidebook says.
My mother thought it too permanent to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a permanent mark on the wall, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next valley called the plan quite permanent, and everybody laughed.
The permanent ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
